newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI buys dollars at 35.79 rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI buys dollars at 35.79 rupees.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) resumed its dollar purhcase from the interbank market on Friday afternoon to prevent the rupee's rise, dealers said.

"They are in the market," said a dealer at a foreign bank. He said RBI bought dollars at 35.79 level to prevent the rupee rising further. The RBI had bought small amounts on Thursday after the rupee breached the 35.80 mark.
The dollar traded today at a low of 35.7900 compared to Thursday's low of 35.7925, dealers said.
Forward dollar premiums edged down, tracking an easing of overnight call rates, dealers said.
